title: Public Alert No. 02/2025 – Illegal Distribution and Sale of Substandard and Falsified (SF) Knowit Insulin Syringe 40 IU 29g X 1/2
summary: NAFDAC warns of illegal sale of substandard and falsified Knowit Insulin Syringe 40 IU 29G x 1/2 in Nigeria. The 40 IU/ml syringe is no longer registered and can cause life-threatening insulin dosing errors. Its NAFDAC number 03-2933 is falsified; licence expired in 2019.
